metadata.name: inflation_zc_swap_5y
metadata.description: Synthetic 5Y zero-coupon inflation swap on deterministic CPI and USD OIS curves.
metadata.source_detail: Synthetic 5Y zero-coupon inflation swap on deterministic CPI and USD OIS curves. Canonical typed market inputs are supplied directly; the pricing tolerance contract is preserved. Amended and re-baselined 2026-09-18. Commit 413953021 made a historical reference anchor require a published fixing rather than a curve projection, so the contract now states its base CPI explicitly. The contract also follows the USD-CPI market convention (one/one accrual, NYSE calendar, modified following, linear monthly reference interpolation), and the curve's declared 3M indexation lag is now resolved by the instrument, so the stated base CPI is this curve's reference level at the lagged 2026-04-30 anchor rather than at the unlagged start date.
metadata.regen_command: manual formula fixture; values captured from canonical pricing runner

plan.description: the canonical typed market inputs are supplied with no calibration steps. Routes through engine::execute without changing pricing math.

npv.tolerance_reason: Formula self-test: tolerance pinned to ~10x the worst observed deterministic FP residual (1.16e-10 abs / 2.8e-11 rel) for canonical pricing on synthetic inputs. Tightening from 1e-6 to 1e-9 catches drift introduced by refactors, FP-contract changes, or algorithm swaps that would otherwise be invisible at the looser band.
